How Deep Can a Leatherback Turtle Dive?.caption:
How Deep Can a Leatherback Turtle Dive? 🐢

Leatherbacks, the giant sea turtles of the open ocean, are record-breaking divers. Tracking tags have recorded leatherbacks diving more than 1,200 meters (over 4,000 feet), the deepest dive ever recorded for a turtle. They go that deep to hunt jellyfish.

How Slow Can a Blue Whale's Heart Beat?.caption:
How Slow Can a Blue Whale's Heart Beat? 🐋

In 2019, scientists tagged a wild blue whale off California and recorded its heartbeat for the first time. During deep feeding dives its heart usually beat just 4 to 8 times a minute, and sometimes only 2 times a minute. Back at the surface, it sped up to 25 to 37 beats a minute.

Do Killer Whales Go Through Menopause? 🐋.caption:
Do Killer Whales Go Through Menopause? 🐋

Female killer whales are one of the very few animals, like humans, that go through menopause. They stop having babies in their 30s or 40s, but can live into their 90s. Those grandmothers stay with their families and help them survive.

How Big Are a Giant Squid's Eyes? 🦑 #sho.caption:
How Big Are a Giant Squid's Eyes? 🦑

Giant squid have the largest eyes of any animal on Earth. Each eye can grow to about 10 inches across, roughly the size of a dinner plate. That is nearly three times wider than the eyes of any other living animal.

How Many Eyes Does a Box Jellyfish Have?.caption:
How Many Eyes Does a Box Jellyfish Have? 🪼

A box jellyfish has 24 eyes, grouped into four clusters of six. In each cluster, four simple eyes sense light and dark, while two have lenses that can form images. The upper lens eyes always point upward, no matter how the jellyfish turns.
